item.description:
This page's content changed since the last check. Visit the page directly to review the update.
What changed (text excerpt): Added: + (Updated September 8, 2026) + on a proposed amendment to Rule 4A of the Maine Rules of Unified Criminal Procedure to allow consideration of a complaint certified on information and belief. Comments due by September 18, 2026. + SJC + invites comments + on proposed amendments to the Maine Rules of Evidence to permit parties to authenticate certain electronic evidence other than through the testimony of a foundation witness. Comments due by September 29, 2026. Removed: - (Updated March 12, 2026) - on - proposed amendments - to the Rules of Civil Procedure on minors as parties in protection-from-abuse matters. Comments due by March 31, 2026
